name: Progressive Multiscale Loading
definition: A rendering strategy where each frame picks the appropriate resolution level per volume region, aiming for approximately one voxel per screen pixel. Coarse data fills the view first, and finer data replaces it region-by-region as it arrives, producing a complete coarse view within seconds that sharpens in place.
summary: Progressive Multiscale Loading dynamically selects volume resolution per frame based on projected size, avoiding precomputed hierarchies and enabling coarse-to-fine refinement.
